provenance.method: hand tally from question text (no parser involvement, by design)
provenance.purpose: meth-F5: independent leg/avoid counts to detect silently dropped route legs, where evaluation instrument and pipeline share the parser.

count_rules.n_route_legs: ordered movement clauses (go to X / go near / via / pass by / take the path near / take the path between A and B / then / after that). A 'path between A and B' corridor clause counts as ONE leg. The terminal goal counts as a leg.
count_rules.clauses: one quoted fragment per counted clause (route legs then avoids); len(clauses) == n_route_legs + n_avoid.
